    '-I'+str(base/'source/lib/qdldl/include'),'cpp/cuda/tests/qoco_recreate_probe.cpp',
    '-Wl,--no-as-needed','-L'+str(base/'final'),'-lqoco','-ldl','-o',str(probe/'proxy.so')],check=True)
shutil.copyfile('/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-device-io-v63/cuda-tests/native_qoco_conversion_test',probe/'native_qoco_conversion_test')
for p in probe.iterdir(): p.chmod(0o555)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('SPACEPDHCG_TEST_')}
env['SPACEPDHCG_QOCO_LIBRARY']=str(probe/'proxy.so')
for suffix in ['TRAJECTORY_ORDERING','KKT_COMPARE','DEVICE_IO_REQUIRED']:
    env['SPACEPDHCG_TEST_QOCO_'+suffix]='1'
env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=f'/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-device-io-v63/final:{base}/final:/home/angus/cudss-isolated-0.8.0.10/nvidia/cu12/lib:/usr/local/cuda-12.8/lib64'
checks=[]
with Path('/home/angus/.spacepdhcg-gpu.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    for tool in [None,'memcheck','initcheck','synccheck','racecheck']:
        cmd=[]
        if tool:
            cmd=['/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/compute-sanitizer','--tool',tool,'--error-exitcode','99']
            if tool=='memcheck':cmd+=['--leak-check','full']
        cmd += [str(probe/'native_qoco_conversion_test'),'4','trajectory']
        run=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
        checks.append({'tool':tool,'command':cmd,'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr})
        Path('build/performance/gpu-kkt-v67-recovery.json').write_text(json.dumps({'checks':checks,'sha256':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in probe.iterdir()}},indent=2)+'\n')
        print('recovery',tool,run.returncode,flush=True)
        assert run.returncode==0
